in_engine_not_documented.NATURALJOINUSAGE: The engine has it and describes it: 'Adds a table as Natural Join into filter context.' No page under query-languages/dax documents it, so there is no card. A gap in the library rather than in the engine.

note: All nine on the first list are among the sixteen uncategorised functions of docs/decisions/2026-08-17-sixteen-functions-without-category.md. The other seven of those sixteen -- COLLAPSE, COLLAPSEALL, EXPAND, EXPANDALL, ISATLEVEL, SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX, TOPNSKIP -- ARE in this engine. Two lists that overlap that cleanly are probably one fact seen twice, and that is a lead worth following rather than a coincidence worth recording.
